text: ]] Yeren are a Mockery Breed of wereapes of the World of Darkness.
Yang Prana is a Discipline of the Kuei-jin, that allows the manipulation of internal Yang.

Father Walter Stanford is a Monsignor of the Society of Leopold, responsible for leading the efforts to eliminate the Kindred presence in Boston. He is protected by the True Faith from Vampires and their powers.

Uthra Suri is a twelfth generation Indian Ravnos and the sire of Adri. After Adri witnessed a battle between several vampiric creatures, he ignited the dry grass and drove both parties off. Later, he was visited by a group of Ravnos and Uthra who Embraced him as cannon-fodder in their war against the Kuei-Jin.

Ugallu are one of the Families of Beasts, representing nightmares of Exposure. They often take the form of flying monsters such as rocs, gryphons or dragons, and stalk their vulnerable prey from above. This gives them the nickname "Raptors." However, not all Ugallu take on flying forms; some approach the idea of "exposure" differently, and instead their Horror reflects the idea of always being watched. The Ugallu Birthright allows them to uncover things that are hidden without a roll or Satiety expenditure. Raptors can find common ground for kinship with nearly anything, with the exception of Sin-Eaters -- there's no sky in the Underworld. Ugallu frequently pursue the Retreat Inheritance, an
The Uratha are werewolves, creatures of flesh and spirit whose duty is to protect the world from creatures of the Shadow Realm.

Amaroq was a werewolf raider during the time of the Viking raids. Amaroq, alongside his pack, the Black Claws, attacked Octric's Beshilu-ridden village during the Viking raids. It was he who, with a spear, landed the killing blow on Octric himself. Unlike the more soft-spoken Hrafn and Brum, Amaroq seemed to revel in the hunt.

The Bloodline Discipline of the Gangrel-based Annunaku, Tenure gives a vampire an uncanny awareness of his mystically-bonded haven, or Demesne. Users of Tenure are known as Landlords. Legends tell of ancient Landlords who called down storms on their land to drive away invaders. This Discipline is described in detail in .

Tarique is a powerful Sihr sorcerer who founded the Hajj bloodline. In contrast to other Nosferatu, he wears his disfigurements openly and proudly, seeing them as marks of Allah's wrath. He is considered the leading imam of the Ashirra.

Stephen Thundran is Research Association for the Progenitors who works closely with Dr. Ishida. He tricks Andrew Greene, Mary Beth and Rob into giving up DNA samples. Stephen has always had a photographic memory, which lead his parents and teachers to over-estimate his intelligence. At some point this finally lead to a dramatic mental breakdown during which he Awakened. Stephen's Avatar takes the form of a belligerent flaming, verbally-abusive clown; only his girlfriend (Marcie), who is secretly a Verbena Disciple, can calm it down. Stephen has a reputation for being sarcastic and rude, though part of this may be his Avatar speaking through him. Deep down he is quite close to his colleagues

Suleiman the Wise, often anglicized as Solomon, was a powerful mage and king of Israel in the tenth century BCE. The Order of Hermes identify Suleiman as a student of the Cult of Thoth and a practitioner of Hermetic-style magic. His grimoires The Greater Key of Solomon and The Lesser Key of Solomon remain fundamental Hermetic texts. Suleiman is also acknowledged by the Taftani for devising the basic rotes for binding djinn during the War of Enslavement. These rotes, as well as his observations about djinn and other spirits, were recorded in the Solomonic Code. The War of Enslavement or the 10,000 Djinni Plague began after construction of the Temple of Jerusalem was completed. Suleiman had th

Stonebones are one of the sub-types of the Ogre seeming. These changelings resemble the rocky giants of folklore, Nordic trolls, Native American mountain spirits and the like. Theirs is the blessing of Obdurate Skin.

The Sorcerers, or Sorcerer Caste, are the smallest caste within the Banu Haqim, but the second most recognizable. They claim to have practiced blood sorcery since the times of the Second City, and to have been created to counter the dark magic employed by the Baali. Their magic was originally based on ancient Mesopotamian priestly rituals and the Persian cult of Mithras, but modern Sorcerers now incorporate the ecstatic Hindu devotion to Kali and Shiva, Chinese feng shui, and Islamic alchemy and astrology as well. from Rage Across Russia]] Shazear is one of the seven Zmei from Russia. He is able to shapeshift and assume human form.
The Protected People or the Seven Wells Bane is a spirit that blinds mortals to the presence of supernaturals in the town of Seven Wells, Sudan.

Seçil was said to be an eyeless spectre that wandered the Tower of London in Victorian times. Rumor held that she would inflict a sickness on her victims such that they would die, coughing up blood, by the morning. She was known to spare young women who begged clemency.

These spirits, the most obvious agents of the Scourge, are poetic justice incarnate. Some are clearly demonic; others seem to be angels. Some remain invisible to mortal eyes, while others seem as mortal as a milkmaid. All of them are beings of frightening power. The magus who crosses swords with a Scourgeling will be lucky if he lives to regret the act. Scourgelings are early forms of Paradox Spirits from Mage: The Sorcerers Crusade.

The Aeon of Spirit, commonly referred to as Snake, is, alongside the Aeon of Life, the ruler of a realm in Astral Space — specifically, that which represents the Path of Thyrsus. Its palace varies from oases to bamboo stands to jungles, but inevitably is some reflection of nature. A shapeshifter whose form often reflects the symbolic tastes of visitors, the snake is among the most common shapes the Aeon takes, hence its name. Most visits to the Aeon of Spirit are made for the purpose of seeking out lore regarding the Shadow, about which Snake is most knowledgeable. The Nemean, Hierarch of the Boston Consilium, claimed to have stolen a scale from the Aeon Snake.

In life Scarlett Grant, real name Abigail Dennehy Grant, was a married woman who constantly fought with her husband until he killed her. In death, she became a wraith of the Hierarchy of Atlanta and became a part of the Ponce de Leon Ladies Haunting Society.

Salomon ibn Jedah ibn Gabirol was an influential Jewish Lasombra present in the city of Ceuta during the Medieval era. In 1148 CE, he was destroyed after the sacked the city. Despite being able to hide himself and his Jewish people in shadows, he was discovered by the Ashirra Farouk ibn Sa'id and destroyed. His remains were sought nearly a century later by the surviving cainites, Don Ibrahim and Isaac ibn Mushad.
S.B. Ronson is a Master of Stonecrop of intermediate influence who used the tainted sorcery of the Masters to transform themself into a wolf-shifter.

Rob "Superbeast" Steele is a notable figure in the XWF wrestling franchise. His quantum powers allow him to morph into a large muscular beast, with enough command of dormancy to allow him to return to his natural human form. When in "human" form Rob sidelines the front man for a skew-metal band named: Süperbëast. While morphed into the beast, Rob is colorblind.

Rhea O'Connor, also called The Harbinger, is a werewolf known for infiltrating activist causes only to drive said movement into a death spiral of extremism, violence, and internal schisms. She believes wholeheartedly that the world is coming to an end, and soon, and thus deliberately stirs up discord to draw as much attention to that fact as possible.

Reuben Trimby is a Galatea following the Refinement of Gold. He is made from the body of a boy aged 13. He constantly enrolls himself in different schools, using Mesmerism to convince others that his background is in order, whilst using two other members of his Throng to pose as his parents. He always tries to fit in as a member of the class, but each time, the bullying and harassment (from both teacher and student) becomes so severe that he is forced to leave. Reuben has been a pupil in 12 schools in the space of five years. Each time, he’s left under a cloud, but each time, he’s decided that it has been worth it. Whether his experiment will end in disillusionment or triumph has yet to be e

Rafeeq is a Garou of the Caern of Tarker's Mill and is notorious for never leaving his lupus form. During an attack on an Endron facility, he is killed by his fellow Cahal Filin whilst blinded by rage.

Pythagoras was an ancient Greek philosopher who contributed greatly to modern mathematics, music, and theology; indeed, he is credited with coining the term "philosopher" itself. He was also an Awakened mage and an early forerunner of the Order of Hermes.
The Pumonca, also called Stormwalkers, are the werecougars of the Bastet tribe. They are the restless wanderers and guardians of the Bastet, and constantly on the move to protect their sacred home.

Prias was the ghoul, guardian, and mortal lover of Helena, an ancient and powerful Toreador methuselah. He had followed Helena through the ages as a ghoul, protected her and been instrumental in her war against the Brujah methuselah, Menele. Having digested Helena's Fourth Generation blood over three millennia, Prias was an exceptionally powerful ghoul, with abilities comparable to an elder vampire. In fact, his aura read as a vampire for anyone who inspected him with Auspex.

Pranksters and comedians, Pooka are well-loved by kithain and mortal alike, but few who know them will ever trust them completely: they are incapable of telling the whole truth. Each is able to take on the form of a specific animal, most often one with a tie to human stories of mischief.

In life Pansy Ledbedder, real name Scarlett Ledbedder, was a polio child who engrossed herself in romance novels until she was murdered in a robbery gone wrong. In death, she became a wraith of the Hierarchy of Atlanta and became a part of the Ponce de Leon Ladies Haunting Society.

Old Man Fisher is a Mortal Kami Host who believes that aliens adducted him when he was young and charged him with protecting aquatic life of all kinds. He instructs local children in his small fishing village to respect water creatures and makes certain that no one over-fishes the lake he considers his territory. He can be a formidable opponent as well as a staunch ally.

Nittu Ronchetti is a prominent Malkavian of the Genis of Palermo, and the Camarilla Keeper of Elysium. Nittu causes a Masquerade breach by openly fighting the rival Ventrue Eleonora Ferrante in front of kine. Later, he confesses he felt teaching Eleonora a lesson by bending her to his will, through the Dominate discipline. He is a thin man with a blond ponytail. Nittu was rumored to be Prince Marc de Clécy's lover.
The Musician is a spectre who first appeared in the streets of the Paris Necropolis in 1927.
Mysancta is a Lasombra Cardinal of the Sabbat. An experienced adept to Abyss Mysticism, spending most of the time in Shadow Form.
Nar-Sheptha was a 6th generation Assamite Sorcerer of great renown until she died and became an incorporeal guardian to the Great Library of Alamut.

In her living days, Neith was a member of the Cult of Isis and a staunch opponent of the Followers of Set. For her heroic deeds in a battle against the vampiric servants of Set where she died, she was granted the Spell of Life and returned as one of the Shemsu-Heru. As one of Horus's greatest warriors and his personal bodyguard and assassin, Neith has mastered warcraft over thousand years and has quickly adapted to the new methods of killing. Sadly, her bloodlust has eroded her mind in her many lifetimes, making her cold and dissatisfied with her victories. Only the bloodiest, hardest battles manage to ignite her interest.

Melody Trelawny is a wraith who resides in Hong Kong. She was once a runaway from the U.S. who got caught up in the X-Rated Porn Flicks and other perverse things in her mortal life. She can be found almost anywhere in the city.

A form of psychomorph that appear in the Adventure! age. The precursors to Trinity's Psions, mesmerists are the Inspired who tap into the fields of the mind due to the telluric energies unleashed by the Hammersmith Incident. Weaker in nature than their psychic descendants, they make up for it in their flexibility and the focus of their inspirations.
Mazen ibn Tarique was a Nosferatu and part of the Hajj. It is known that he was one of the most proficient Sihr sorcerers, having been tutored by one of its inventors, his sire Tarique.

Marcus Kiley is a Brujah and the Sheriff of South London. As a mortal, he was a professional boxer. Captured by Operation Antigen as he fought them alongside the Anarchs and Duskborn he is usually at odds with in his territory. He's currently being used as a research subject in order to create better biological weapons against IC0s.
Mao Lun is a Kuei-jin of the Righteous Devils of Kowloon and a specialist for the flow of chi. He resides in the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sai_Wan Western District].

Lynx-Killer is a Red Talon Galliard. He got his name from an encounter with a Qualmi on his sept's hunting grounds. The Garou tried to warn the Qualmi off, but the cat just mocked him, rolling on its back and then assuming human form. Lynx-Killer reflects that he wouldn't have bothered with the warning if he'd known how stupid the "Eyes of Gaia" were.
, Ghost Wolf Elodoth member of the Lodge of the Thin Shadow]] The Lodge of the Thin Shadow is an elite espionage-focused lodge.

Dr. Linda Smith-Nevans is a member of the Progenitors and a close colleague of Drs. Ishida and Burns. Smith-Nevans began her career in 1894 when she became one of the first women admitted to the Convention on an equal basis with her male colleagues. She has fought hard for her status and does not tolerate disrespect. Smith-Nevans is now on her third body and is preparing for her fourth. She is accompanied everywhere by Hadji, a brown miniature poodle she has modified to serve as her bodyguard. If Hadji senses his mistress in distress, he can activate a Talisman in his collar that allows him to grow to the size of a small horse in order to defend her. Letitia Shy was the Sheriff of North London. She for her role by her sire and predecessor Juliet Parr, Letitia is a Malkavian with an uncanny ability to read people and separate truth from lies. She was destroyed in the Operation Antigen raid on Queen Anne's party.
Lady Bolevile is a True Fae who manifests alternately as the lady of the manor in which she lives and the manor itself.
Laughing Ones are capricious, shapeshifting hobs that revel in tricking those that climb onto them for a ride.

Kànbujiàn (Chinese: 看不見; lit.: 'invisible'; 'unable to be seen') are Kuei-jin that have taken the Second Breath outside the Middle Kingdom and somehow managed to transcend their chih-mei phase out of sheer force of will.

The Lammasu, also known by their modern sobriquet Defilers, are the former angels of God who inspired and searched for truth, beauty, and inner power in Demon: The Fallen. Inspiring the others to war, the Defilers were used for morale and healing spiritual wounds, strengthening the inner resolve of their fellow Fallen. When they fell, were cast into the Abyss, and then escaped, the Defilers became focused on continuing to influence humans, but not always for pure purposes.

A Lawgiver is a type of Spectre found in Orpheus. Lawgivers act directly as an extension of the will of Grandmother, doing her bidding, controlling and coordinating Spectral hives, and generally making life miserable for all of the ghosts within their reach, especially Orphan-Grinders. Lawgivers are special Spectres in that they are the only kind that were once Orphan-Grinders; many Orphan-Grinders live in fear of returning to the fold of Grandmother, and do their utmost to avoid it. For those who fail, the price is high; the Orphan-Grinder's dark side, or Gemini seeks it out and transforms into a writhing mass of chains. One length of chain shoots back into the Stormwall (and eventually, Gr

King Semyonov is the ultimate perversion of the long-extinct Grondr: a Skull Pig born with the ability to change form. The self-styled monarch leads a sounder of fellow Skull Pigs on a rampage across the US southeast, having allied themselves with the Pentex subsidiary Circinus Brands.
Khara were weresabertooths. They were the first tribe of the Bastet - also referred to as Two Twin’s Cubs by their descendants.

Kahina is a powerful Setite Sorceress and one of the two heads of the Dream Court. Unbeknownst to many, Kahina's true form is repugnant, appearing pestilent and desiccated at the same time. She uses Obfuscate to hide this from other Cainites.

Jebediah Roney was a Gangrel and the sire of the courier Nicholas. As he hunted a mountain lion in wolf form, he was found by lupines. As they hunted Jebediah, he attempted to merge into the earth, but the lupines caught up and destroyed him.

A small clan with origins debated by those few kindred that know of them, Jiang Shi are vampires that were created by "replacing the blood of an ordinary person with the blood of one extraordinarily pure". Said Jiang Shi can usually tell by simply tasting a given kine's blood if they are suitable. This process generally means two must die for a single Phantom to be born, though the blood need not be fresh or from a living donor. Their bite is always numbingly cold, never causing the euphoric state that other kindred enact when feeding. They can return to their grave through sheer force of will, wherever they are in the world, but become more corpse-like when low on Vitae. When in this state,
Isamu Harujiro was a vengeful spectre of a renowned sword master and sword smith of medieval Japan.

The Iltani are an ancient Mekhet bloodline, purported to originate in Babylonia. The founder of the bloodline, Nanshe Iltani, resented the En Isiratuu for stealing away her lover and her ex-lover for going with him willingly. She learned the art of Mérges sorcery, which allowed her to quite literally distill her hatred into a deadly poison, and tricked her ex-lover into administering it to the En. The poison, the modern En claim, weakened Isiratuu enough that the Edimmu were able to consume him. Nothing more is known about Nanshe Iltani. Modern Iltani are rare, and many Kindred believe the bloodline has died out. Through Mérges sorcery, they are able to refine their negative emotions into po

Hiram "Slag" Goldberg was an early nova and a probationary member of Team Tomorrow at its founding in 1999. Described as "immensely charismatic," he had the power to manipulate flames and molten metal. When T2M was asked to leave its US base of operations in 2002, Goldberg became a full member of Team Tomorrow Europe. Goldberg was part of the Team Tomorrow unit sent to Nigeria in 2001 due to elite involvement in the Equatorial Wars, and was killed by Totentanz. This battle resulted in T2M's policy of not engaging enemy novas unless they had a two-to-one advantage in numbers. A cartoon series about Slag apparently continued for several years past his death, and in 2003 his action figure was s

Hispo is the near-wolf form of the Garou. It can be described as a massive wolf of nightmare, a throwback to prehistoric days when the dire wolves were the size of ponies. It’s a form designed to hunt and kill.

Hiram Bollingsworth was Endron International's first president. He was so successful that several Pentex board members (including Harold Zettler) got nervous and arranged for a fatal accident to kill him 1959. Unsurprisingly, Hiram's ghost lingered long after he did, and eventually learned the secret of sliding back into the Skinlands and became one of the Risen. He's begun stalking Zettler.

Hautala was a Viking raider of the early Medieval era and the second-in-command of Captain Erik the Wolf. He led his chief into the lair of the vampires who had abducted Erik's daughter, Signe Eriksdotter. Erik ignored Hautala's advice and rushed into the cavern and they were quickly slaughtered by a vampire Signe and her pack mates. The sole survivor, Hautala was able to set fire to the lair, killing several of the "demons," but as he escaped to his boat, he was met by Erik, a newly-Embraced vampire himself.

:The Centurion Droids are non-sentient drones from the Generation One continuity family. s look smart.]] The Centurion Droids are an automated defense guarding the Vector Sigma supercomputer. Though possessing no weapons, Centurions are trained in hand-to-hand combat to stop all intruders. They also possess very strong armor that protects them from attacks, making them even more dangerous. They tend to be encountered in large numbers. They must be either evaded or tricked in order for one to approach Vector Sigma. Fortunately, that's not hard.
:Beck is a character in the Go-Bots continuity. Beck is a very strong Go-Bot. He is also a rather lazy one.

:Twitcher F451 is a Decepticon Real Gear Robot from the live-action movie continuity family. Twitcher F451 is a dumb-bell. After a few minutes of observation, he can formulate a target's complete psychological profile, including all of their weaknesses, hang-ups, and frailties. He then exploits all of those weaknesses to the best of his abilities, an act in which he takes immense pleasure. He likes it so much that he "practices" on his fellow Decepticons, ensuring that even his teammates treat him like Cosmic Rust.

Transformation is the process by which a Cybertronian alters his/her form between modes. It shouldn't be confused with reformatting. All Cybertronians can transform into any kind of vehicle, weapon, animal, etc. Whatever they want on Cybertron or on Earth. A transformer's Transformation Cog enables them to physically transform. Without it, they wouldn't be able to do this.

Swarms are small flying critters with a habit of attacking Transformers. They build their hives anywhere, including the debris field around Trypticon station and even deep within the fortresses of Iacon and Kaon. Though they're more pest than anything, they can be deadly if there are enough of them, and they grow to the size of a small Transformer.

:Speed-Bot is a character in the Go-Bots continuity. Speed-Bot is the fastest of all the Go-Bots, and can take on a wide variety of speedy vehicle forms. His incredible speed is both his greatest strength and his greatest weakness, as this young 'Bot has a tendency to jump into action before completely thinking things through.

The Shotgunner has a regenerating overshield, and carries a EMP Shotgun. They are very dangerous at close quarters, but lose their dangerousness if you are sniping them. They also carry Flak Grenades and Stun Grenades.

:Rhinobreast is a Decepticon in the Generation One continuity family. The Rhinobreast is the Breastforce partner of Drillhorn. Mostly a mindless beast, he can become a robotic rhinocerus or a handheld blaster.

:Radrogue is an Autobot-allied Mini-Con from the Generation One/Beast Wars continuity family. Radrogue is the fast-running leader of the Autobots (or Maximals; presumably those that accompany him, rather than the entire faction). He proclaims, "I will keep the rules of justice!"

:The Madmachine is a wacky robot bug from the Headmasters portion of the Generation One continuity family. The Madmachine is a Decepticon invention resembling an Earthen horseshoe crab, scuttling around on small legs with a hard-shelled outer layer. It projects electromagnetic beams from its forward protrusions, which can cripple electronic computer systems, and have a limited paralytic effect on Transformers themselves. RTM dub name: The Magnetic Bug

:Koala Gray is a Beastformer in the Generation One continuity family. Koala Gray is one of the Autobot Beastformers fighting a war on the planet Beest. His role in the Autobot Beastformer forces is commander of grasslands reconnaissance. He also holds the rank of King of Lapol, the country in whose inland region he was born, over Emperor Duck Diver. :English name: Killer Koala

:Kreb is a Headmaster Nebulan from the Generation One continuity family. Kreb is an obnoxious former talk show host who revels in the disgusting and rude. (Like there's any other kind of talk show host?) He transforms into the head of Horri-Bull.

:Haywire is an Autobot-aligned Nebulan Targetmaster from the Generation One continuity family. One of the younger Nebulans to binary-bond to a Transformer, Haywire is very much of the "act first, think later"-impulsive-teenage mold. In that respect, the relationship between Haywire and his partner Blurr is one where they get on like a house on fire, but also a classic example of the lack of planning in the early stages of Targetmasters bonding for how effective a combat team they would make. Transforming into an electro-laser cannon, Haywire is just as hyperactive as his partner in combat, often more concerned with how often he fires than where he's aiming or how effective his shots are.

Thoth-Amon (also spelled Thoth-amon) is a character from the Conan cycle (: "The Phoenix on the Sword" [ Robert E. Howard ]) and Cthulhu Mythos stories. (: "The Haunter of the Ring" [Robert E. Howard]) He is a Stygian wizard and at one time possessed the Serpent Ring of Set (also called "The Ring of Thoth-Amon"). (: "The God in the Bowl" [Robert E. Howard])

Shoggoths are fictional creatures created by H. P. Lovecraft, first appearing in his novella At the Mountains of Madness (1936). They are depicted as amorphous, shapeshifting beings who were genetically engineered by the Elder Things as a race of servant-tools, but eventually rose up against their masters. The monsters were later mentioned in Lovecraft's The Shadow Over Innsmouth (1936) and "The Thing on the Doorstep" (1937), and have become one of the most widely shared elements of the Cthulhu Mythos.

R. Layamon is a fictional character who appears in Philip José Farmer's short story "The Freshman". Layamon is a professor at Miskatonic University, the chairman of the Committee of the Occult Arts and History Department and a powerful wizard. He is affiliated with the Lam Kha Alif fraternity. Farmer provides a description of Layamon: Throughout the story, Layamon is pushing the new student Roderick Desmond to cross a moral line, to eliminate the "defects of character" that would keep him from fulfilling his arcane potential.

Lobon, also known as Lobon of the Sacred Spear is one of the Great Ones, the gods of Earth that reside in Kadath. He appears as an ivy-crowned youth bearing a spear. (: "The Crawler of Pnoth" Mike Minnis) Lobon was one of the chief gods worshipped in doomed Sarnath together with Tamash and Zo-Kalar. All three were depicted in Sarnath as graceful bearded men. (: "The Doom That Came to Sarnath") Lobon dislikes conflict and usually avoids fighting. His Sacred Spear is not merely a weapon; it is an extension of himself and a symbol of who he is. In addition to protecting its owner, the spear can fly at the owner's command and carry small objects and animals. (: H. P. Lovecraft's Dreamlands)

Harpies are a legendary species of winged female creatures from Greek mythology. Traditionally, their physical appearance is that of a human-sized bird of prey with the head of a woman, or a female humanoid with avian legs and wings. Harpies are featured in H. P. Lovecraft's poem "Hallowe'en in a Suburb", and mentioned in the opening quote of "The Dunwich Horror", which is from "Witches and Other Night-Fears", by Charles Lamb.

Intelligent mollusks are a telepathic race of creatures which inhabit the seas of Venus in the distant future. They are mentioned in Brian Lumley's Cthulhu Mythos novel The Transition of Titus Crow. In the same book Titus Crow further states that ten million years later all life on Venus has died but it is unclear if the mollusks still survive elsewhere.
The Witnesses of Manwë were sacred Great Eagles of Manwë that kept watch upon the great mountain of Meneltarma, near to the center of Mittalmar in Númenor.

Werewolves were servants of Sauron. They were bred from wolves, and were inhabited by dreadful spirits that their master had imprisoned within their bodies. Werewolves inhabited Tol Sirion, which hence became known as Tol-in-Gaurhoth ("Isle of werewolves").

Rogash was a troll that joined the Witch-king of Angmar in the conquest of Arnor, believing in promises of unification between the warring Snow Trolls and Hill-trolls. He was known as the "Troll of the North" by friends and foes alike. He had the built and strength of an average troll but his skill with swords was equal to a trained swordsman. He is a playable hero for Angmar in . He was slain during the final assault on Angmar. Rogash is not in any canonical works of Tolkien.
Asfaloth was the trusted white horse of the Elf Glorfindel. One of the horses of the Elves, Asfaloth was naturally faster than ordinary horses, even the steeds of the Nazgûl.
The Ice Golem is a rare Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Snow biome during Blizzards, day or night. It walks slowly and fires blue Frost Beam projectiles that chill and occasionally freeze players.

__NOTOC__ The Granite Golem is an enemy found only in Granite Caves. Every few seconds, it will shield itself from all attacks making it completely invulnerable (note that it can still deal contact damage to players during this invulnerable state should they walk into it). It can drop the Night Vision Helmet rarely, and will always drop a small amount of Granite Blocks, just like the Granite Elemental.

The CSM-107 T-810 Advanced Stealth Infiltrator is a variant of the Series 800 Terminator developed by Skynet. Equipped with Holo Matrix, the T-810 is a Terminator specialized in infiltration missions where it can be hardly detected by the Resistance. In addition, the T-810 features a superior targeting system while programmed with Skill Upgrade: Marksman, making it an ideal sniper.

was an Italian bodybuilder and actor who portrayed the Future Terminator in The Terminator (1984). Franco, being only 5'5" in height, was one of the shortest bodybuilders in existence. Despite this, he had climbed to the top of the professional circuit to obtain the title of Mr. Olympia in 1976 and 1981 (succeeding Arnold Schwarzenegger on both occasions). The 1981 victory was gained in spite of a serious injury he suffered in 1977's World's Strongest Man competition, where he severely dislocated his leg. Franco became known in America during the late 1970s where he performed strongman feats such as manually inflating water bottles, lifting entire cars, and being able to press 700lbs.
The Cyberdyne Systems Series E Experimental Exterminator Unit, or TE-X30, colloquially known by the Resistance as the “Hover Hoover” or "Tex", is a pest control unit created by Skynet.
Utsusemi (空蝉, "Empty Cicada") is one of Guy's special attacks, exclusive to the OMEGA Mode of Ultra Street Fighter IV.
Teleport is a special attack performed by Arkane and F7 in arcade version of the Street Fighter: The Movie game.

Nakagami Yousuke (なかがみ ようすけ Nakagami Yousuke?) is the character from the tenth Street Fighter Laboratory corner. A young man who hardly comes out from the home he got from his parents. Having multiple real estates, he seems not to be troubled with money. For some reason he is training his body with muscle training. It seems he shatters PC monitors with an intense punch while saying "Yo guys, let's meet next week!"

Killer Chefs are enemies from Final Fight: Streetwise. They are chefs fought alongside mobsters in Vito Bracca's restaurant in Little Italy. They fight with knives. They can slash at Kyle up close, or throw knives at him from afar. They also have a dash move where they pin Kyle down and stab him. Ted Samsa was a terran present at Dead Man's Rock just prior to its fall to the zerg, though whether he actually lived on the world or was part of the Dominion Armada fleet sent to apprehend the fugitives Jake Ramsey and Rosemary Dahl just prior to the invasion is unknown. Regardless, it's known that he was among those caught up in a telepathic field generated by Ramsey.

Temlaa was a protoss warrior and historian of the Shelak Tribe near the end of the Aeon of Strife. His duties included guarding xel'naga relics from attacks by hostile tribes. He looked up to his mentor, Savassan. From him he learned how to conceal his thoughts from other protoss (a common ambush technique during the time period). The relics were poorly understood. They couldn't be studied using psionic powers (they had no minds to read, nor did they have a "psionic interface") but they were covered with writing - the protoss used psionics exclusively to communicate and did not understand the concept. He is known to have possessed at least one "blood-kin", Raamar.

Space Pirates are ghosts who work for the Kimeran Pirates, a mercenary organization. Two of them are known by name, Twitch and Manic. They had superior combat ability compared to most other ghosts from their era, but preferred to use stealth rather than murder, as killing opponents tended to draw attention. They had access to high technology from Velichek, a Kimeran Pirate scientist; they could cloak for longer periods. They also used low-energy Lockdown shells which the Kimeran Pirates had stolen.

Rimmicu was a protoss of the Templar Caste who served alongside Iaalu. During the Great War, Rimmicu had lost his entire unit to a pack of zerglings, as well as all of his limbs. Through his will, he used the remains of his muscles to fly a hover-platform modified from interceptor parts. He then broke from his orders, and started hunting down every zergling he could find, before finally being killed by a zerg queen. The last words he said to Iaalu, "Uhn dara ma'nakai," ("Our duty is unending" in Khalani) would stay with him through his service, and drive Iaalu to push through immense pain.

"Rook" was the name for a terran ghost coined by Nova Terra and Malcolm Kelerchian, as per his real name being classified. He was cocky, had an IQ of over 150, and lead his team during his time at Ghost Academy. As of 2503, Rook was fresh out of the Ghost Academy, hence the nickname. That year, he was part of a team of ghosts under the command of Nova Terra as part of counter-insurgency operations against Project Shadowblade. To this end, he was dispatched to investigate events on Altara, with the team finally being wholly assembled on the Palatine. Of the group, he had the highest psi index. Later, Rook was assigned to the team to defend Arcturus Mengsk from a spectre uprising. However, the
The rhynadon is a slow rhinoceros-like life form. It possesses a thick, armored hide and a large horn. Rhynadons are native to Moria. It has also been introduced into Korhal's ecosystem.

Plasma surge is a psionic power demonstrated by protoss high templars. It involves channeling psionic energy into the plasma shields of protoss warriors, regenerating their shields. High Templar Karass demonstrated this ability, and could regenerate the shields of protoss around him. During the End War, high templar honed their abilities to aid in their race's darkest hour, learning to channel the power of their psionic storms into the shields of their allies.

Purifier blades are arm blades used by the Purifier Talandar. These blades are made of a solid material as opposed to the usual psionic blades of the protoss. Talandar has two of these blades per arm, and can use these in a whirlwind attack, spinning and hitting all opponents surrounding him.

Psionic transfer (referred to as "ghosting" by the Terran Dominion) is a type of psionic power utilized by adepts. This ability allows them to project an invulnerable image of themselves and teleport to its location after a short period of time. This ability is useful for scouting enemy positions or circumnavigating defensive emplacements. This ability is enabled/helped by the use of a psionic amplifier.

Psychic healing is the process of using psionic powers to heal wounds and/or regain one's bearings after being stunned. This ability is possessed ghost Kare Vaessen, after the removal of her psychic dampeners. Nova Terra seemed to use this ability to heal Gabriel Tosh during a training mission, after he was caught in her massive psi-blast.

"Oma" was the named used by Lila to discuss her guardian on Altara. They lived in an apartment there, one that suffered many break-ins. "Oma" exploited Lila's telepathic abilities to her own ends, and dismissed the girls concerns when she raised them, chalking up her abilities to nightmares stemming from a vivid imagination. In 2503 the pair's apartment was broken into, only in this case, the intruder opened fire. "Oma" was killed in the gunfire while Lila escaped.
Octavia Bren is a terran resident of Bhekar Ro and sister of Lars. She is strong-willed and an unregistered, untrained telepath, possessing psychic sensitivity and a degree of premonition.

The mecha lurker is a Mecha Swarm replication of the lurker created by Egon Stetmann, designed to protect his sacred home of Bel'Shir, and were controlled via technopathy. During the End War, these lurkers can be equipped with programs to focus on one enemy, and tunnel itself to a new location while damaging enemies in its path. They were evolved from the mecha hydralisk.

Mend is an psionic power demonstrated by Sarah Kerrigan during the Second Great War after she was reborn as a primal zerg. Using this ability, Kerrigan can psionically twist essence, healing herself and nearby zerg creatures. Dehaka also has the ability to mend himself and nearby allies.

Leaping strike is an psionic power demonstrated by Sarah Kerrigan during the Second Great War after she was reborn as a primal zerg. Using this ability, Kerrigan leaps high into the air, coming down on a single target and tearing through them.

Ladranix was the leader of the Shel'na Kryhas, a protoss faction stranded on Aiur. Ladranix wore battered golden armor and fought with psionic blades. He was capable of incredible feats of jumping. Ladranix considered the Dark Templar to be a dark and shameful secret.
Kasai flyers are bulbous creatures native to Jarban Minor. They possess the ability to float above the ground.

Guraj was the Second Ascendant of the Tal'darim. Like most other ascendants, she was constantly fighting the others for influence. Her skills included poisoning the minds of rival factions. She was cunning and clever but poor at creating allies. In combat, she could wield her blades very quickly.

Gestalt Zero is the prototype protoss/terran hybrid created by Project Gestalt. He has a ghost's hostile environment suit and semi-human face with a nose. He has a Psi-Index of over 7 and has 187% of the combat effectiveness of a normal ghost. He is equipped with a psionic blade and pistol, and often fired paralyzing darts (effective against the protoss). He was also proficient with the use of small remotely-detonated bombs. His loyalty to the Terran Dominion was enforced with a neural inhibitor.

Lieutenant Commander Fleet was a Confederate pilot in the Colonial Fleet. Her Valkyrie was equipped with special cloaking technology. In the last days of Tarsonis, Fleet was assigned to transport the 22nd Confederate Marine Division to Fagin's headquarters along with Wrangler Malcolm Kelerchian to capture Nova, who was a top-priority object to the Confederate military since many of the Ghost Program's agents had been killed during the conflict with the Sons of Korhal and the zerg. She successfully deployed the marines and got them out of the combat zone.

Colin Phash is a young terran child and the son of former Senator Corbin Phash of the Terran Dominion. He has psionic powers which can be used to kill zerglings and is good at hide and seek. His powers include a "quiet voice" which prevents the zerg from detecting him, but it requires concentration. Phash became a trainee at the . He was later freed and became a Umojan Protectorate shadowguard.

Hurdle is a Daimon who Eudial sent to help her extract a Pure Heart. She can wrap threads around her victims to trap them, and is a fast runner. She has a giant shoe in her gut, similar to Taiyan. She appeared in Episode 17 of Sailor Moon S.
Sakiko is a little girl who appears in the 20th episode of the 90's Sailor Moon anime. She is a child with strong psychic powers forced to relentlessly train them under her Father.

Mizuki Ueshiba A member of the School Committee, Mizuki Ueshiba approaches Tsukune after he is nominated to participate with the School Festival Committee. Unfortunately, he accidentally reveals himself to be the mole Tsukune is looking for in the Student Committee, alerting him to the presence of ANTI-THESIS. Ironically, his own abilities and true form reflect that of a snake, able to bury his victims underground. However he was defeated by Tsukune's vampire form.

Sirens are a mythical half-man half-bird creatures from ancient Greece that lived by the sea. Originally, they were referred to as a god whose singing voice had the power to disrupt the minds of those that listen to it. In fact this creature is the root word of the English word "Siren."

Modified Humans (改造人間 Kaizō-Ningen) are humans with magical powers known as Youjutsu (Monster Arts). This species had not been seen in Rosario+Vampire until Tsukune Aono, a human who had his body reconstructed, and stuck with 109 needles. These needles had threads of energy that stitched and reconstructed his cells to form channels that amplified the energy inside Tsukune's body, which was the source of his Youjutsu. This technique, called the Human Modification Technique, had been developed by the dark lord, Touhou Fuhai. When the technique was completed, Tsukune emerged as the very first known Modified Human.

Onimodoki are a variant of shape-shifting monster that can duplicate a monster's features at will. Unlike the Doppelgangers, however, they do not have the ability to mimic the monster's powers and abilities. At the same time, they do not require physical contact to transform to the monster they wish to be.

The Hand of the Titan is a recurring character in the saga Rock of Ages. It's a giant hand that descends from the sky and helps the Rock of Ages get back on the road whenever he falls off the ledges, always teleporting it back to the last solid platform it landed onto. While its true nature is unknown, it seems apparent it only makes part of a larger and powerful humanoid creature akin to Atlas or God himself, seemingly being omnipresent. The Hand never directly participates in any of the conflicts involved in the saga, but is willing to rescue ANY boulders that might need to get back on track, showing to be unbiased. The is a returning floating mask monster in Risk of Rain 2 that is propelled by fire. It is part of the monster family.
Lurkers are Tier 3 Archæans that appear in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Extraction. They are capable of making themselves and other enemies invisible.

Alan Decker was an empath, which is a low level telepath according to Andrea Rollins. Decker was also a descendant of Ellen Ripley and because of this, he was targeted by s, who can sense that he is related to Ripley as she was apparently genetically marked.
Subotai was an immortal Japanese samurai who'd been fighting Predators since they arrived on Earth, and became part of Spearhead.

The Runner, also known as the Dog Alien, Ox Alien, The Dragon or Scout, is an adult form of the species Xenomorph XX121 spawned from a quadrupedal host animal (such as a dog or an ox). Runners, as their name implies, are fast and agile, and can spit acid from their mouths. They are considered "stage IV" Xenomorphs and molt into Sentries once they've secured a hive and a regular source of hosts. Runners have variously been portrayed as being slightly larger or slightly smaller than typical human-spawned Aliens, differences that no doubt derive from the animal that hosted the creature. However, the Runner encountered on Fiorina 161 was around 7 feet 5 inches tall when standing on its hind legs

The Raptor, also dubbed the Xeno-Flyer, was a -like pathogenic mutation of the giant hawk, an avian creature native to the Union of Progressive Peoples mining planet Shānmén. Raptors possessed leathery wings with a ten-foot span and an inner mouth phalanx for striking prey.

Dawn was a female synthetic employed by the United States Colonial Marine Corps who believed that she was psychic. According to USCM Private First Class Alex Tulae, she could predict the future and tell a human exactly what they were thinking. The unit's lieutenant explained this away as a "mind game" - an artifact of the android's mental capacity. Dawn was also considered lucky by her unit; when she was assigned elsewhere, the Marines in that unit began to experience adverse circumstances.

The Defender was a caste that resembled the Drone, known for its bullet-resistant mesoskeleton. As its name would suggest, the Defender essentially acted as the opposite of a Warrior, protecting other castes with its reinforced mesoskeleton, which also allowed it to safely gather hosts in the midst of a battlefield.
Pocked Lanternbearer is a type of Pocked found in the mines of Act 4. Pocked Lanternbearers can throw firebombs which leave a yellow burning ground.
Paradisae Venenum is a unique Plumed Chimeral located on the second or third level (After 1-2 set of stairs) of The Upper Sceptre of God in Act 3. He can consume corpses to regain health.
Cannibal Fire-eater is a type of Cannibal found in the Coast. Has a fire breath attack (a short range piercing projectile) and a melee attack.

Carrion Queens are very large Carrion bugs which spawn Carrion Minions and shoots Fireball-like projectiles. These projectiles have limited range. These projectiles can be enhanced when a Carrion Queen is raised using Raise Spectre using projectile enhancing skill gems such as Volley Support, Greater Multiple Projectiles Support, Fork Support etc.
Vultures are a type of monster found in Act 4. They are large flying monsters who will charge towards the player.

Voidbearers are monsters found in Act 3. They breathe fire and deal more damage from afar. They can be dangerous, even more so if they fire multiple projectiles. Even though these monsters use a skill that looks like Incinerate, their damage is not purely fire, some of it is also physical.
Vaal Arsonist is a type of construct with a ranged fire attack. They are found in corrupted areas and the Vaal areas of Act 2.

Kouzuki Toki, née Amatsuki, was the wife of the daimyo of Kuri, Kouzuki Oden and the mother of Kouzuki Momonosuke and Kouzuki Hiyori. She was born around 830 years before the present day. By the time she was 26 years old, she jumped forward in time with her Devil Fruit ability and arrived 30 years before the present when she met Oden and stayed with him for 10 years until he was executed. She was killed during the destruction of Oden Castle.

Hanafuda, also known as the "King of Lizards", was a former Warlord of the Sea and affiliate of the Beasts Pirates who was defeated by Portgas D. Ace four years ago. Following his expulsion and eventual death at the hands of rival pirates, his Warlord position was given to Bartholomew Kuma. He was also the father of Ulti and Page One.

Kigiri can produce an extremely thick smokescreen which immediately makes the opponent cough and blinds them, it also covers up the scent of the user and his allies. He may then attack at free will. Obito teleports himself above his opponent and crashes down onto them, stabbing them with a kunai.
Guren materialises a blue crystal blade on her forearm to engage in combat. It has proven to be durable enough to block shuriken and kunai. If need be, she can create a crystal blade on each forearm.

Pakura strengthens her feet with the power of Scorch Release, delivering fatal blows to her opponents using taijutsu.

After using the Multiple Shadow Clone Technique, Naruto Uzumaki and his shadow clones simultaneously throw shuriken at a target. Because of how many shuriken there are and how many directions they're thrown from, the target, regardless of how skilled they may be, cannot reasonably dodge all of them. As such, their only real option is to try and shield themselves to minimise the damage. This focus on the shuriken inevitably creates blind-spots in the target, which is the actual purpose of this technique: the many Narutos can focus on these blind-spots to execute additional attacks.
Utakata blows acidic bubbles from his pipe that burn anything it comes into contact with. The sheer multitude and wide-range it can cover makes avoiding it very difficult.
Kinshiki manifests a giant axe, flies at his opponent, and delivers a sweeping slash at them.

Yamato strikes the opponent with a series of punches and kicks leading to him jumping into the air and releasing a wooden spear from his palm that is directed into the opponent and used to drive them into the ground. pl:Drewniana Przebijająca Dłoń

By transforming their arm into a tree, the user can then create multiple branches which will rapidly grow around the target, immobilising them. This technique is strong enough to restrain a giant squid.

Using the Ketsuryūgan's ability to manipulate a target's iron-rich blood, the user can expand the blood in the target's body. Doing so, it will cause the body to morph into a much larger version, effectively disguising the target to be unrecognizable from their true form. By cutting their wrists to expel the extra blood, the target will return to their original state.
Transformed as Kokuō, Han tramples his opponents twice, by his left and right, rams into them with his horns, and finishes by spinning and swatting at them with his tails.
Using his father's White Light Chakra Sabre, a young Kakashi delivers a series of slashes, finishing with a downward cut.

Orochimaru transfers his consciousness into a white snake and then slithers into his target's body, enabling him to gain control of their body as well as their mind. This technique is similar in concept to the Yamanaka clan's Mind Body Switch Technique, where the user's original body is left defenceless after taking control of someone else's. The user creates drops of water from an outside source, which are then shaped into razor-sharp lotus petals. As the petals expand in size and spin around, emitting explosive energy in every direction, they are launched at the opponent. The petals can be controlled and are able to kill a man with a single petal. Hisen noted it to be his strongest technique.
The user blends in with the rain to be near by the enemy. When used by Tsurugi, he can summon rain around him at will.
Tobirama uses his mastery of the Water Release to materialise a small body of water to rise up beneath the opponent and thrusting them into the air.
Sarada jumps high and throws an explosive tag laden Fūma Shuriken at her opponents, while also throwing healing seal laden kunai at her allies.

This technique releases the seal on the Fury technique and then accumulates natural energy from the earth and atmosphere to be used for the technique. The bearer of the seal acts as a passive vessel, continuously gathering natural energy, which makes it possible to use Fury without their cooperation.

A technique passed down in his family, Gekomatsu creates chakra copies of shinobi living or deceased, such as Jiraiya and Orochimaru. Only those who possess the special chakra beads can see the created chakra entities.

Koji links with his artificial toad to access their point of view, seeing and hearing everything around the toad. This can be done via special software or through Koji directly, in which the latter case his pupils will become toad-like. It allows for more discreet surveillance and intel gathering. He can also use two toads to communicate with others if one is left with the person they are in contact with. The connection can even be maintained between separate dimensions.
Kimimaro delivers a series of slashes to the opponent with two bone swords until he sends them flying into the air, where he delivers a series of slashes at lightning speed.

Gozu can change parts of his body in a manner that is reminiscent of the Akimichi clan's Partial Multi-Size Technique to increase the strength and range of his attacks. With the acquired knowledge of how the near-future will happen, a perfect counter-strategy can be formed from being able to accurately tell how the enemy will act. However, due to the effects of the technique, the user experiences more time than those around them, putting the user at risk of prolonged exposure to hazardous conditions. fr:Remontée Temporelle
Sasuke attacks his opponent with a series of sword slashes and a roundhouse kick, before hitting them with a forward lunging, horizontal slash.

Kidōmaru spits several small nets from his mouth at a target or targets; the nets' small size means they can be produced rapidly, increasing his chances of striking his target. The nets are made sticky with chakra, causing them to cling to targets on contact and adhere them to whatever other object or surface the nets touch. The more nets a target is struck with, the stronger the binding. As with all of Kidōmaru's webbing, targets can free themselves by injecting their own chakra into the nets, such as with the Gentle Fist.

Kidōmaru imprisons a target in a cocoon of spider threads. Because of how tightly around the target the spider threads are stretched, they are unable to move once they've been trapped. Kidōmaru can further constrict the threads by flowing additional chakra into them, to the point of ultimately strangling the target. The threads are produced by mixing Kidōmaru's saliva with chakra, making them exceptionally sticky. As with all of Kidōmaru's webbing, targets can free themselves by injecting their own chakra into the threads, such as with the Gentle Fist.

The instant before they are to be struck by an attack, the user replaces themselves with a block of wood or something similar. Because the attack does hit something, opponents may briefly believe that they've successfully struck the user. But this is merely an optical illusion and opponents will quickly notice what's happened. If users are fast enough, they can use this brief lapse in the opponent's attentions to stage a counterattack; in the anime, the replacement log itself has been shown used as an attack, being applied with explosive tags. Alternatively, this is a good opportunity for users to escape.
While in her bat form, Kamira can exhale a smokescreen from her mouth. The smokescreen appears to be a diversion technique, as when used against Kankurō, it had no lasting effects.

As the name suggests, this technique is simply a soundless method of killing an opponent by striking their vital points, usually from behind with a blade. Additionally, because the user moves silently, the attack cannot be anticipated and defended against. The user will often slit their opponent's throat, preventing any cry that might give them away. Some shinobi also opt to use a cover such as mist or even frost to rob their opponents of their field of vision and then attack them using it as cover.

The user can temporarily increase the size of their body parts or their entire body at will. When using it on their belly, the user can make it spin faster and in great speed. While used on the entire body, the user can easily repel close-range enemy attacks.

Using their modified flesh, the user hardens it to throw projectiles. In the anime, Kawaki can also wear the flesh fragments on his hands or feet for hand-to-hand combat, akin to brass knuckles.
Gaara manipulates his sand to swirl around himself, acting as a shield against projectiles.

The puppeteer wraps the enemy with chakra strings in an effort to bind and restrict their movements, and then has their puppets spew water onto the opponent. This technique was especially effective on Gaara as it prevented him from manipulating his sand which was soaked in water.

Darui repeatedly slashes his opponent with his cleaver sword, finishing it with a powerful spinning attack that knocks them far back.

By using a small portion of Gyūki's chakra and sacrificing one of its tentacles, Killer B can create a flawless clone of himself that neither the Sharingan, nor the Akatsuki, could distinguish. With a swipe of its claws, Kurama can create a miniature tornado.

Kakashi uses Lightning Cutter and runs extremely fast towards his opponent, he then grabs them, dragging their body on the ground for a long time and finally ejecting them.

An Aburame has thousands of their kikaichū gather together until they've taken on the size and appearance of the Aburame, to be used either as a decoy or a diversion. The insect clone can be created anywhere that the kikaichū are positioned or sent to, making it more useful for certain tasks than a shadow clone. When the insect clone is struck, it disperses back into a swarm of kikaichū. In the anime, the insect clones take a solid enough form to coordinate with the user for joint attacks.
The user emits a black fog from their body to conceal themselves.
Pakura covers herself with fire, amplifying the effect of her Scorch Release attacks.

The user exhales a large quantity of fine powder from their mouth, which due to its luminous quality, shines so brightly that it can temporarily blind multiple targets within its area of effect. This momentary handicap can be utilised either by the user or their allies to attack the opposition whilst their vision is still impaired.

The user summons several snakes from under their sleeve, deploying them against a target as a surprise. The snakes do as their summoner commands, attacking or capturing targets by biting or constricting them. The snakes can also help the user latch to the surroundings, pulling the summoner towards a destination to help them get around faster. Because of the snakes' length, they can be used from a fair distance away.
Ultilising the gunpowder mixed in his black mist, Boro covers his fists with mist and ignites it with each punch he delivers to the opponent.

Yūgao swings her sword in a circular motion, leaving a trace of afterimages behind, which befitting the technique's name, mirrors that of a moon. Yugaō will then rush at them to deliver a blow, taking advantage of the difficulty in following her movement.

After placing fūinjutsu tags in an area, the users create a sealing barrier that takes the form of an ethereal monkey hand that cages the target. With a piece of the Stone of Gelel embedded in the back of his right hand, Haido can blast objects without the need to make physical contact with them. Itachi creates a water clone to punch and hold the opponent. Kisame slashes them into the air while using the remains of the destroyed water clone to summon a water shark to strike the opponent. The opponent falls in the wake of Itachi's Tsukuyomi in which the opponent withers away as though they were water. pl:Saikyō no Shikaku

Medusa is a mythological creature, known for her ability to turn any who stare at her to stone. She served as inspiration for a skin and slime retexture in Greek Mythology Mash-up, the latter of which was later adapted into a character in the second season of Minecraft Mini-Series.

B.B. was a computer hacker who assisted the mercenary Snake, and ex-FBI agent Dalton, during the terrorist incident at SaintLogic. He viewed the incident as some kind of game and occasionally contacted Snake though the Codec with advice. In the end, General Wiseman sent his troops after him revealing that B.B. stood for BlackBoard and that B.B. was operating out of a small computer lab in St. Crescendo Elementary School, located in the state of Virginia. However, B.B. was able to hypnotize the U.S. President just in time through his computer monitor and arranged for the DoD to arrest Wiseman.

When spotted by an enemy soldier, their perception of time slowed down, enabling them to quickly defeat the soldier and stop them from raising an alert.
The Monkey Robot duo were a pair of minor antagonists from the Mazinger Z manga. They could fly through the air using unseen rockets.
Mamirez was a ghostly and freakish Spectral Warrior Beast that served as the main antagonist in the 40th episode of Great Mazinger.

Commander Hulk is a member of the Vegan Empire with special equipment that allows him to shapeshift. He appeared in episode 29 to pose as an Earth child named Haruo Shusho to get close to the Grendizer through Goro Makiba.
Mario N7 is a flying saucer-like "anti-human" Mechanical Beast that appeared in the Mazinger Z manga. It was controlled by Count Brocken for his operations on a mountain pass.

The Phantom is a Cerberus unit encountered in Mass Effect 3. The terrifying result of reverse engineered Reaper technology, these unnervingly agile biotic cyborgs are a deadly threat to the enemies of Cerberus.

Rachni Brood Warriors are rachni who are much larger and stronger than normal Rachni Soldiers. They are the 'elder males' of the hive that usually mate with the queen. According to historical information, it is said that they only attack when the hive is particularly strained for warriors. The Brood Warrior has abilities comparable to a standard Rachni Soldier, although its attacks inflict more damage. It is also unique among rachni in that it possesses some biotic abilities. Brood Warriors will use Warp, occasionally place a squad member in Stasis, and appear to use a form of Barrier. Their hind legs and tentacle-arms glow with biotic energy whenever they use one of their biotic abilities.
The Observer is a Remnant unit. On the battlefield it fulfills the role of basic ranged support, dealing continuous damage while floating overhead.
Vanguards are biotic warriors. They combine biotics and weapons to take down opponents, and are especially deadly at short range. They use pistols and shotguns, and can specialize in medium armor.

Major Kyle, an Alliance officer who served during the Siege of Torfan, has amassed a small but fanatical group of biotic followers. He has already killed two Alliance officials sent to investigate their compound in the Hawking Eta cluster. The Buzzard is a friendly character in Donkey Kong 64. It is first seen locked in a cage near Snide's H.Q. in Angry Aztec. After Diddy Kong frees the Buzzard from the cage by flying through the ring with his Jetbarrel on top of the giant statue three times, it decides to challenge him with a game; if Diddy manages to fly through all the rings it drops, the Buzzard will reward Diddy with a Golden Banana.

The Bilin Usagi no Ōjo is a princess that rules over the talking rabbits that live in Mario Land that appears in Super Mario Land 2 - 6-tsu no Kinka 1 of the Super Mario Kodansha manga. She looks like a human, wearing a bunny head helmet with the words "Bilin Usagi" ("Bilingual Rabbit") on the back of it, and a outfit. While facing off Wario controlling the Mario Zone robot, Mario rescues a rabbit from being squashed by him. Grateful, the rabbit takes him to the princess, who rewards him by giving him the Carrot, from which to gain their powers in Bunny form. She briefly reappers in the second chapter to remind the reader what the Carrot does.

Aiko () is the seventh sample talent in Mario Artist: Talent Studio. She has black hair and purple eyes and wears a black suit jacket and long boots. According to her talent no namae profile, she is a witch and her hobby/specialty is making sweets. Aiko also appears as a character in the sample movie "Hotcake" and narrates it. Yukimaru are snowman enemies on skis that are found exclusively in Wario Land II, where they breathe snowflakes at Wario. If one of these hits him, he transforms into Frozen Wario. Yukimaru are only found in Syrup Castle, Invade Wario Castle, Uncanny Mansion, and The Really Final Chapter. They are reminiscent of Bucket Heads from Wario Land: Super Mario Land 3.
Yeti (雪男,Yukiotoko) is an enemy in Wario Land 4. This pudgy creature attacks by shooting icy breaths that transforms Wario into Frozen Wario. de:Yukiotoko

Vine Slimes, also known as Slugs, are slug creatures that crawl up and down vines in the depths of Torrential Maze in Yoshi's Story. They are blue and can move their two eyes from one side of their bodies to the other when they reach the end of a vine. Vine Slimes are indestructible and can only be avoided. They appear only in the aforementioned level. In the original Japanese version, Vine Slimes and their vines do not appear, and the areas where they are found in the international versions instead contain Ghost Streams; the background was not touched up to remove the ghost holes.

The Water Crystal is one of the four Elemental Crystals who fights alongside Culex in Monstro Town in Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars. It is a sentient crystal associated with the element of water. The Water Crystal, like the other three Elemental Crystals, originates from the Final Fantasy franchise, but in Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars, the Water Crystal is from the dimension of Vanda, like Culex. The Water Crystal almost exclusively uses Ice-based moves, such as Blizzard and Ice Rock, even though it has "Water" in its name. Ironically, the Earth Crystal can use Water Blast but not the Water Crystal. It has medium Attack status but a rather high Defense.
Blowtorch Guy (カタカタかえんヘイホー) is an enemy in Mario vs. Donkey Kong. It is a blue Shy Guy toy that attacks using a blowtorch.

Tanoombas are Goombas based on the Tanooki Suit that appear in the Mario & Luigi series. They resemble regular Goombas, except that a Tanoomba has raccoon ears, a raccoon tail, and a leaf on its forehead. Tanoombas are also slightly larger than most other Goombas. Tanoombas have powerful mimicry abilities and are able to shapeshift into different objects and different creatures. However, Tanoombas can always be given away by the raccoon-like features or leaves that appear on their transformations.

Beam Robota (ビームロボタ Bīmu Robota) are enemies which appear in Wario Land 3. They are blue robots and a variant of Spear-bots that attack Wario by shooting beam blades at him, cutting Wario in half for a few seconds before he automatically returns to normal. Beam Robotas have a relative named Fire Robota. de:Beamrobota
A large boar-like creature that Yoshi can ride on. It can jump high in the air and rotate its face like a drill. Appearances: Yoshi and the Mysterious book
Hebarii (へばりぃ) is an enemy in Wario Land 3. It is a pink slime that moves on ceilings and attacks by shooting beams at Wario. de:Roofslime

The Gray Magikoopa is a special type of Magikoopa in Paper Mario. They are abbreviated as GRY Magikoopa in the game. The Gray Magikoopas can turn allies invisible, and appear solely in the Crystal Palace. Unlike the game's other Magikoopa colors, Gray Magikoopas are never shown riding broomsticks, though they have unused sprites for it. Like all Magikoopas, they duplicate themselves or run away if alone in battle. In Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door, their abilities are given to Green Magikoopas.

Fred de Fillet is the boss of World 4 in the game Yoshi's New Island. Fred de Fillet starts out as a normal Jean de Fillet living in lava, but is then enlarged with Kamek's hammer and is also provided with body armor. He attacks by sending Lava Waves or by dropping Flightless Skeleton Goonies at Yoshi, who then has to ground pound a button on top of Fred's armor to make it fall off. With Fred's skeletal body exposed, Yoshi can then hit Fred with an egg to damage him and make him angry, which makes him jump around furiously and attack, after his attacking stage is over, he will turn back to normal. A Fwoosh is a cloud enemy that first appeared in Super Mario 64. It attacks by blowing strong gusts of wind in order to push characters off high altitudes.

Water Stream Mario is an original transformation that Mario takes in Super Mario-kun volume 6. While traversing a torrid desert, Mario, Luigi and Yoshi are attacked by a Blargg in a lake of frying oil. Peach sends Mario a Reitō Power-up Kinoko via a Flying ? Block. Mario grabs it and becomes Water Stream Mario, defeating the Blargg and cooling him and his friends with his water aura powers.

Unchimu is an original RPG-style enemy that Mario and Yoshi face in the last chapter Super Mario-kun volume 7. While looking for the Star Flower in the tall grass, Yoshi comes across a pile of feces and jokingly treats it as an enemy, but much to their surprise, it actually comes to life and fights them back. After shocking Yoshi with a laser from its mouth, Mario awaits for its next move, but the Unchimu explains that, following the RPG rules, it is their turn to attack now. With just a few punches, the duo wins and enjoys the loot.

Uckykongs are characters in Yoshi's Crafted World. They are a combination between an Ukiki and a Kong. Only two appear in the entire game, excluding those who wave at Yoshi. They appear in the level Bombs Away on Pirate Island. If the player Ground Pounds the yellow platform on their boat, a cannon will launch a cannonball at a bell, and when the Uckykong hears it ring, it slams the ground with its hands, giving a wind that causes the boat to go away, with some Uckykongs waving at Yoshi on the background.

Tamagadon is a monster faced in chapter 11 of Super Mario-kun Volume 9. Looking for Luigi in Yosu Ko, Mario, Yoshi, and Bowser-Wanda stop to celebrate Christmas with the Yoshis. Wario, dressed up as Santa Claus, wreaks havoc by dropping eggshell-shaped Buckets onto them. To free them, Bowser-Wanda destroys the suspended Rock Blocks to crack the buckets with the debris. Most of the cracked eggshells then come together, forming a tureen-shaped monster called Tamagodon. Tamagodon first tries to drown everyone by pouring the scrambled eggs inside itself, but the Yoshis eat them. Tamagodon then targets Mario by trying to zap him with its laser eyes, but Mario dodges it until he falls on some eggs
